blurb: Serendipity Dance Co provides dance training in a positive, supportive, and challenging environment. Dancers can take classes from age three through their teen years and participate in performance teams. The studio operates a dance season from September through June.
extraNote: Tuition is due by the 3rd of each month and charged to a card on file · Tuition is not prorated for missed classes, holidays, or short months · Makeup classes are encouraged but have no cash value and must be used by season end · Annual registration fee is required each season · Withdrawal requires notice to front desk before the first of the month · No late fee currently charged · Recital participation is optional and recorded · September through June
